summary_en: TX1 Corporation completed a tender offer for Project Holdings shares and warrants from September 29 to November 11, 2026. The offer was successful with 5,179,837 securities tendered, exceeding the minimum threshold of 3,554,400. Settlement begins November 18, 2026, making TX1 the parent company and controlling shareholder.
title_en: Notice Regarding Completion of Tender Offer for Project Holdings Shares and Warrants by TX1 Corporation and Changes in Parent Company, Related Companies, and Major Shareholders
translation_en_brief:
TX1 Corporation, a newly established company wholly owned by Techno Pro Holdings, completed a tender offer for all outstanding shares and seven series of warrants of Project Holdings from September 29 to November 11, 2026. The offer succeeded with 5,179,837 securities tendered, representing a response that exceeded the minimum threshold of 3,554,400. Settlement is scheduled to begin on November 18, 2026.

Following settlement, TX1 will hold more than 50% of total voting rights and will become the parent company, major shareholder, and lead major shareholder of Project Holdings. Techno Pro Holdings and its upstream entities—BXJ-E One Holdings, BXJE Holdings (CYM) L.P., and BXJE Holdings Manager L.L.C.—will indirectly own Project Holdings shares through TX1 and will also qualify as parent companies.

SBI Holdings, which previously held major shareholder and lead major shareholder status, tendered all its Project Holdings shares in the offer and will no longer qualify as a related company or major shareholder after settlement. Similarly, Yusuke Doi, who held major shareholder status through his direct shareholding and through DY Investment Partnership No. 1, tendered all shares and will cease to be a major shareholder.
